items.summary: Cloud Load BalancingFeatureThe DENY_BY_DEFAULT action for authorization policies isgenerally available (GA) for regional external Application Load Balancers, regional internal Application Load Balancers,and cross-region internal Application Load Balancers.Attaching a DENY_BY_DEFAULT authorization policy to a load balancer'sforwarding rule establishes a deny-by-default security baseline that blocks allrequests unless they are explicitly permitted by a separate ALLOW or CUSTOMauthorization policy.For more information, see the following documentation:* Authorization policy overview* Set up authorization policies for Application Load Balancers
